scenes.headline: End the screen time fight.
scenes.voiceover: Every night, the same argument about the phone. Drift ends it.

scenes.headline: Their chores, on their phone.
scenes.voiceover: You put real tasks on your kid's phone. Homework, chores, practice.

scenes.headline: They prove it. You tap.
scenes.voiceover: When it's done, they send proof. You approve it from your phone.

scenes.headline: You pick what gets blocked.
scenes.voiceover: You choose exactly which apps stay locked until the work is done.

scenes.headline: Screen time, earned. Not begged for.
scenes.voiceover: Screen time becomes something they earn. Not something you argue about.

scenes.headline: Bring peace to the phone.
scenes.voiceover: Drift. Screen time they earn. Peace you keep.
